supplemental.label: SUPPLEMENTAL_NUMERICAL_DIAGNOSTIC
supplemental.state: exact author initial CSV; no interpolation

sampling.extent_interval: 0..1000 s; trapezoidal quadrature on supplemental t0 + 200 stored points; approximate, not an integrated solver extent
sampling.initial_layer: retain t0 separately; primary begins at 1e-4 s; no full initial-layer resolution or closure test claimed
sampling.engine_time_convention: retain stored timestamps exactly; verify first stored state against author x0 and report any start-time ambiguity; no time shift or resimulation

numeric.information_floors_meaning: computational denominator/information floors in the unresolved reference concentration/time convention, never scientific acceptance criteria

formulas.rate: evaluate frozen effective SBML MathML; independently k_r*product(x_s**reactant_stoichiometry) from canonical inventory and author CSV
formulas.stoichiometry: canonical literal stoichiometryMath retained exactly, including re0000000414 -> 2 PO4
formulas.turnover_tau: abs(x_z)/(production+consumption), only x_z>concentration floor and flux denominator>flux floor; turnover proxy, not relaxation eigenvalue
formulas.free_fraction: x_free/sum_registered_members(x_s), only registered, source-checked membership and positive denominator
formulas.bound_fraction: 1-free_fraction; for family-total with degraded sink this is nonfree fraction and includes degraded material, not exclusively bound complexes
formulas.occupancy: x_member/sum_registered_members(x_s), coefficient 1 as in existing explicit member lists
formulas.pool_reference_certificate: exact integer sum of S rows is zero for every author-k!=0 column; unconditional certificate separately checks all columns
formulas.equilibrium_defect: abs(vf-vr)/(abs(vf)+abs(vr)), only exchange>flux floor AND both official directions enabled
formulas.extent: trapezoidal time integral of each directed rate; net extent=forward extent-reverse extent
formulas.local_jacobian: full canonical RHS Jacobian restricted to the exact candidate states listed in each existing card; all source reactions retained
formulas.structural_neutral_lower_bound: n_z - exact rational rank(S_z,Rdep); Rdep are enabled reactions whose MathML depends on at least one z; guarantees left-null modes of Jzz
formulas.relaxation_tau: 1/(-Re(lambda)) only Re(lambda)<-neutral_floor; near-zero and nondecaying modes are not inverted
formulas.slow_basis: turnover proxies for Class-I reaction-interface states outside z; per-time median over informative positive states, not certified slow coordinates
formulas.R_tau: median(interface turnover tau)/median(stable candidate-block relaxation tau), paired at each primary time
formulas.timescale_validity: NEED_MORE_INFORMATION until fast/slow coordinate and validity-domain choices are separately human-reviewed

zero_and_missing.zero_concentration: preserve raw value; turnover and pool denominator metrics N/A where denominator invalid; QSS may be informative when production+consumption>floor
zero_and_missing.negative_roundoff: retain raw signed trajectory and rates without clipping; negative pool members make ratio sample unavailable; report counts
zero_and_missing.disabled_k1: retain all 968 rows; pair defect unavailable if either direction k=0, REFERENCE_DIRECTION_DISABLED
zero_and_missing.missing_pool: UNRESOLVED / N/A_POOL_MEMBERSHIP_UNRESOLVED; no membership inferred from species names
zero_and_missing.missing_units: all values are in current inferred reference concentration/time convention; no authoritative absolute chemical unit claim
zero_and_missing.missing_bound_tokens: BOUND_MOIETY_MEMBERSHIP_UNRESOLVED; no quantitative substrate sequestration from ID-derived composition

registered_pools.source_status: existing candidate member lists, not prior mathematical acceptance
registered_pools.coefficients: 1 for each explicitly registered member; no extra members
registered_pools.quantification: only reference-conserved member sums; unique approved Class-I member is free counterpart; ribosome free counterparts use existing coarse:R30_free/coarse:R50_free singleton definitions
registered_pools.state_scalar_policy: use one quantified active pool when unique; if multiple active token pools keep scalar fields N/A_MULTIPLE_POOLS and link all state_pool_metrics; no collapsing different tokens
